tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is that HTTPS is enforced everywhere, with no plaintext exception, including for internal services and hosts. Plain HTTP is therefore not permitted for internal hosts.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/internal-http.md`. It states that HTTPS is enforced everywhere, with no plaintext exception for internal services or hosts, so plain HTTP is not permitted for internal hosts.

The record for this is thin. It comes from Muninn episode #33, which has trust 1 (seen in the project's transcripts). It is not a formal decision record. #33 is the later of two conflicting statements and says it supersedes the earlier allowance for plain HTTP (#32), so I used it and left the retired allowance out of the file.

The catalog entry #31, "Keep verification on all builds, no exceptions", doesn't mention HTTP, so I didn't cite it. If you want #33 recorded as a formal decision, confirm it explicitly.

The first attempt to write the file with a shell command failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the file-writing tool instead.
